title: Salesforce FIFA Deal Puts Agentforce AI Workflows To The Test
title_zh: Salesforce FIFA 交易对 Agentforce AI 工作流程进行测试
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has been named an Official Tournament Supporter for the FIFA World Cup 2026 and 2027. The multi year partnership will put Agentforce 360, Salesforce AI tools, and Slack at the center of tournament operations and fan engagement.
summary_zh: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) 已被指定为 2026 年和 2027 年 FIFA 世界杯的官方赛事支持商。这一多年合作伙伴关系将使 Agentforce 360​​、Salesforce AI 工具和 Slack 成为赛事运营和球迷参与的中心。

title: Bloom Energy (BE) Valuation Check As AI Data Center Deals And Funding Support Growth Outlook
title_zh: Bloom Energy (BE) 估值检查，因为人工智能数据中心交易和资金支持增长前景
summary: Bloom Energy (BE) is drawing fresh attention as multi gigawatt fuel cell deals for AI data centers with Oracle and Brookfield coincide with strong quarterly results, higher guidance, and management’s commitment to growth without new equity.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy (BE) 正在引起新的关注，因为与 Oracle 和 Brookfield 达成的人工智能数据中心多吉瓦燃料电池交易恰逢强劲的季度业绩、更高的指导以及管理层对无需新股权的增长的承诺。

title: Goldman Is Priced Like a Tech Stock. Investors Can Find Better Deals Elsewhere.
title_zh: 高盛的定价就像科技股一样。投资者可以在其他地方找到更好的交易。
summary: While the fundamental outlook at Goldman looks as good as ever, the stock already reflects that. The shares look pricey relative to peers based on key metrics.
summary_zh: 尽管高盛的基本面前景看起来一如既往地好，但该股已经反映出了这一点。根据关键指标，与同行相比，这些股票看起来价格昂贵。

title: Bodycote Shares Fall After Apollo Pulls Back on Making Firm $2 Billion Takeover Offer
title_zh: Apollo 撤回 20 亿美元收购要约后 Bodycote 股价下跌
summary: Shares in  Bodycote  fell on Friday after  Apollo  Global Management said it doesn’t intend to make a firm takeover offer, ending discussions over a 1.52 billion-pound ($2.04 billion) proposal.
summary_zh: 周五，阿波罗全球管理公司表示不打算提出明确的收购要约，结束了有关 15.2 亿英镑（20.4 亿美元）提案的讨论后，Bodycote 的股价下跌。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
